lead: Yashwant Sinha has built a public profile as an Indian politician, born on 6 November 1937 in Patna.
As of 2026, he is 88 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has held the office of Minister of External Affairs and member of Rajya Sabha and has been recognised with the Officer of the Legion of Honour.
This profile collects the Yashwant facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Yashwant Sinha — Career and Professional Work
paras: Yashwant Sinha works primarily as a politician and civil servant.

He has held the following offices: Minister of External Affairs (2002–2004), member of Rajya Sabha, Member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly, Minister of Finance (1998–2002), Minister of Finance (1990–1991) and Member of the 12th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
